title: [Decision] Should the console's own AI chat read an invoice photo and attach that same upload to the record it files, instead of declining non-spreadsheet attachments?
body:
Filing category: ② a decision only the maintainer can make.

## 维护者速读

- 现象：员工最自然的做法是"把发票照片发给 AI，让它填报销单"。用外部 AI（Claude 等）走 MCP 时，照片在 AI 厂商那边，平台拿不到原文件，只能再发上传链接让人重选一次（#32747）。而平台自带的「问 AI」聊天，照片本来就是传到平台自己的页面里的，现在却直接回一句"当前仅支持读取表格类附件……这些文件的内容我没有读取"。
- 要你裁：自带 AI 是否读取图片/PDF 附件，并把**同一份上传**直接写进它建的记录的文件字段（不再让人选第二次）。
- 推荐：A：读取 + 直接附加，附加仍以当前用户身份、走记录的编辑门，图片与 PDF、限大小。

## One-sentence problem

The one place where the photo's bytes are already inside the platform (the console's own chat) is the one place that refuses to look at it.

## Evidence (reach)

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx` `doSend`: files not matching `\.(xlsx|xlsm|csv|tsv|txt)$` are not sent; the user's message gets `(用户上传了 N 个附件:… — 当前仅支持读取表格类附件(Excel/CSV),这些文件的内容我没有读取。)` (read at framework `d7c3d44e`).
- External-client path measured on a hosted tenant (`pnpm dev:stack --with-ui`, cloud `ff373e02`): `create_record` → `create_upload_link` → user re-picks the file → `read_file` reads it back → `run_action` submits. Works, at the cost of re-picking every invoice.

## Governing text

- objectstack#30892 (closed): "An AI client sees an image the user attaches in its own chat, but it has no bytes to send." True for external clients; not true for the console chat, whose composer holds the `File`.
- `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`: "Every step of the road must hold for both kinds of user."

## Options

| Option | What it does | What the customer sees | Effort |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | Console chat uploads image/PDF attachments to storage as the user (pending `sys_file`), sends them to the model as image/text parts, and lets the agent put that file id into a file field of a record it creates or edits (edit door as the user; only files this user uploaded in this conversation) | "Here's my taxi receipt" → claim drafted with amount filled and the photo attached, nothing to pick twice | ui + cloud AI seats · 2–3 PRs · precedent: spreadsheet attachments (cloud#797) |
| B | Read only: the agent sees the photo and fills fields; attaching still goes through an upload link | Fields filled, photo picked again | ui + cloud AI seats · 1–2 PRs |
| C | Keep declining non-spreadsheet attachments | User types the numbers or uses the form | none |

Business reading: A makes the built-in assistant the shortest path for expenses, claims, contracts; B halves it; C keeps it a spreadsheet-only helper.

## Recommendation

A. The bytes are already the user's own upload inside the platform, so attaching them raises none of #32747's provenance question (the user picked the file; the agent only routes it). Confidence gap: model vision cost per image and the size cap; recommend images ≤ 10 MiB, PDFs through the existing `read_file` text extraction.
Self-check: ①②③④ all pick A or B; only ④ alone would accept B first.

## After the ruling

A: composer uploads non-spreadsheet attachments as pending files; the agent gets them as parts plus their file ids; a write that names such an id in a file field commits it; e2e: one photo in chat → a draft claim with the amount and the photo on `invoices`.

os-decision-facets
① 项目长远合理性: A 让文件只上传一次、由用户本人上传，复用现有文件字段和编辑门。
② 实际业务拉动: 报销（发票照片）是最常见的"拍照即录入"场景，本次实测用户第一反应就是把照片发给 AI。
③ 防 AI 犯错: A 只允许附加本人在本对话里上传的文件，agent 不能凭空造文件；读出的金额仍可用 read_file 复核。
④ 创业阶段不扩散: B 更小，A 多一步附加；都复用现有通道，不新增对外接口。
Prior rulings read: #30892 (external-client upload link); #32747 (open, one link for several files); thread: none

Reader who acts: the `domain:ui` seat (`AiChatPage` composer) and the cloud AI seat (agent message parts and the attach step), after the ruling.
Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue AI chat image attachment` → 31 hits (#30892 closed, external clients; others PM seats); `repo:objectstack-ai/cloud is:issue chat image attachment invoice photo` → 0; `Non-spreadsheet attachments chat` → 0.
